title: Feelings Toolbox ABC
hook: Use one support, then notice whether it fits.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D feelings storybook, expressive friendly faces and simple social-emotional tools, uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Feelings Toolbox ABC

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child selecting an emotional-support tool
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Feelings Toolbox ABC a metacognitive toolbox: cards, meters, timers, quiet spaces, gratitude, communication, movement and affection are categorized as naming, waiting, communicating, reflecting, resting, or connecting tools.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child chooses a tool by goal and checks whether it helps; tools are not treatments or personality tests.
